item.name: Rebirth 1
item.unlocks: Teleport (Portable Cannon); Auto Hatch; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); Castle Key (Spinny Wheel, Trading Plaza, Garg Machine); 10,000 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: The first prestige step, opening the rebirth reward track.

item.name: Rebirth 2
item.unlocks: Clans; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); Active Huge Pets can be hatched (best egg only); 25,000 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: The second step, stacking more permanent boosts on top.

item.name: Rebirth 3
item.unlocks: Pet Teams; Enchant Loadouts; Access to Secret Rooms; Index Rewards; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 50,000 Diamonds; Slingy; 15 Basic Coin Jars
item.cardSummary: The rebirth that matters for explorers: it unlocks Secret Key access to the game's hidden rooms.

item.name: Rebirth 4
item.unlocks: Ultimates; Access to Tech World (Rocketship); Mastery; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 100,000 Diamonds; 2 Piñatas; 2 Lucky Blocks; 3 Party Boxes
item.cardSummary: The big one: Ultimates, Mastery, and the rocketship to Tech World all arrive here.

item.name: Rebirth 5
item.unlocks: Ability to hatch Secret Pets; Area Quests; Shiny Chance Boost; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 5 Piñatas; 5 Lucky Blocks; 3 Tech Chest Keys; 3 Tech Spinny Wheel Tickets
item.cardSummary: Deepens Tech World progression with another band of permanent strength.

item.name: Rebirth 6
item.unlocks: Charged Eggs (high luck, 20× cost); Golden Eggs (guaranteed golden, 50× cost); Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 5 Tech Chest Keys; 10 Tech Spinny Wheel Tickets; 10 Mini Chests; 10 Large Gift Bags; 500,000 Diamonds
item.cardSummary: A mid-ladder step that keeps scaling pet strength and rewards.

item.name: Rebirth 7
item.unlocks: Increased Ultimate Speed (30%); Increased Pet Strength (+75%); Increased Ultimate XP (20%); Increased Huge XP (20%); 5 Tech Chest Keys; 10 Mini Chests; 10 Large Gift Bags; 10 Tech Spinny Wheel Tickets
item.cardSummary: Permanently boosts ultimate charging speed by 30 percent and ultimate XP by 20 percent.

item.name: Rebirth 8
item.unlocks: Superior Mini Chests can spawn; Access to Void World (Black Hole); Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 10 Tech Chest Keys; 1 Void Chest Key; 15 Tech Spinny Wheel Tickets; 15 Mini Chests; 15 Large Gift Bags
item.cardSummary: The second-to-last rung with the heaviest reward bundle before the cap.

item.name: Rebirth 9
item.unlocks: Ultra Mastery XP Potion (instantly levels a mastery to 99); Supercomputer Radio; Increased Pet Strength (+75%); 10 Tech Chest Keys; 1 Void Chest Key; 15 Tech Spinny Wheel Tickets; 15 Mini Chests; 15 Large Gift Bags
item.cardSummary: The current cap. Everything after this is horizontal progression.
